notes.title: Lovely Planet 1+2 OST on Vinyl
notes.notes:
Hello Lovelies 💖

It's the 10 year anniversary of the release of the original Lovely Planet! 🎉

To celebrate, we're announcing a set of freshly pressed vinyls that include the original soundtrack we all know and love, from BOTH Lovely Planet AND Lovely Planet 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211895/019e87d71c05429ad58117c8323ac520e3a4557e.png[/img]

Get the catchy, jazzy, upbeat soundtracks by Calum Bowen (a.k.a. Bo En) on a single vinyl! Includes all 12 original tracks and the 2 Maxo remixes from Lovely Planet and Lovely Planet 2: April Skies! Listen to the OST on [url=https://calumbowen.bandcamp.com/album/lovely-planet-original-soundtrack]Bandcamp[/url], [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/6Dy9AkmLb4w9ipONRvDSpb]Spotify[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yX2zzSnxT74&list=OLAK5uy_kB1VTS6LjTRRoNdCqKtlxlVy8PgLQiHdU]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/lovely-planet-original-game-soundtrack/1461681846]Apple Music[/url]!

Available on bio-vinyl as a Limited Signature Edition (signed by the composer Calum Bowen) and Open Edition (without signature).

Manufactured in the UK at [url=https://pressonvinyl.com/]Press On Vinyl[/url].

Composed and produced by [url=https://calumbowen.bandcamp.com/]Calum Bowen[/url].
A7, B7 remixed by [url=https://calumbowen.bandcamp.com/]Maxo[/url].

Front Cover Artwork by [url=http://www.mushbuh.com/]Mushbuh[/url].
Back Cover Artwork by [url=https://www.instagram.com/niptong/]niptong[/url].

Mastered by [url=https://www.airstudios.com/cicely-balston/]Cicely Balston at AIR Studios[/url] and Dan Larkin.

[url=https://www.veryokvinyl.com/products/lovely-planet-1-2]Very Ok Vinyl[/url]
[url=https://manawave.co/products/lovely-planet]Mana Wave[/url]
[url=https://blackscreenrecords.com/products/lovely-planet-1-2?variant=49693927735562]Black Screen Records[/url]
[url=https://www.vinylguru.co.uk/collections/chipfreq/products/ichz0002]Vinyl Guru[/url]


Thank you for playing and your continued support 🙏

notes.title: Update 13.4
notes.notes:
Hello there!

A quick update to fix the [b]issue of FPS drop[/b] in levels with expanding red-blob things. This update limits their size so the game engine doesn't feel the heat from checking collisions between supermassive objects.

Also the on-screen animation from being killed by a red-blob was missing and has been restored ❤️‍🩹

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211895/13f97e056aee7be231119311679601e25fd2e6a6.gif[/img]

Another unique bug allows players to use the expanding red-blob thing to shoot into the sky, aptly named the "[b]Superman Bug[/b]". I have made changes to address this but I think it's still possible to hit the right spot and launch into orbit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35211895/26abdf49e00d5227ec8136cb05977db0c78c133f.gif[/img]

Hope you had a great weekend! Until next time 🙌

Infinite Bliss ✨

notes.title: Update 13
notes.notes:
[h2]Upgrades![/h2]

Hello there Lovelies 💖

Hope you're all doing well! Got this small fix ready that updates the underlying engine to a newer version. The game now supports modern x64 macOS too. An on-screen UI element now shows your time on level failure. This is toggled through the same Timer option in the settings menu.

Let me know if there's any hidden bugs here! If you haven't tried the new entry in the series, I'd suggest giving [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1604780/Lovely_Planet_Remix/]Lovely Planet Remix[/url] a look see! It's got a demo too if you'd like to try it out first!

notes.title: The Lost Levels (Update 12)
notes.notes:
Venture into the Abyss beyond the Summit in Lovely Planet 2: The Lost Levels DLC with a whole new section of the game to experience the fastest most challenging levels ever seen in a Lovely Planet game EVER.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/0ea62710470714ec6e2df32118a4b4eccc785a56.gif[/img]

World 6 (codenamed "ROKU") combines elements of the original Lovely Planet with the sequel to rekindle the cutthroat levels of difficulty we all know and love.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/de110bfbd0aad4454e00b72b96559ba1a9cb139c.png[/img]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/360b271217f77bcd9dce76311ad03117c52a68ea.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/6751c460e8a65b25f4f552b2a85e8ebd0a2c28ee.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/1e47d18fb9bf7ceb1133a5dd76adb641ede9aabf.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/f21a07badee65c429a94a8af86dd6ab39185c893.png[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/2e75e5213f8b68155d8248a4ac43aeb943f0e09b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/58b74a0b52949cf1d6725bdc78c3a72ed3bdd507.png[/img][/url]

Baddies from the original game team up with new traps and enemies of April Skies to assemble god-tier courses that will test your skill like never before.
[list]
[*]Prepare to nurse the restart button as you pull impossible stunts flying through levels at breakneck speeds.
[*]Tear through the very fabric of spacetime teleporting in and out of the action while trading in milliseconds.
[*]Diligently attempt, analyse, recalibrate and rehearse every step, jump, strike and turn with meticulous care and precision for a perfect run to earn stars.
[*]Become one with the art of repetition and retrain every muscle in your hand to earn a spot on the global leaderboards.
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to the Arcade! (Update X)
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to the Arcade![/h1]

Now that you’ve learnt every level like the back of your hand, it’s time to put your skills to the ultimate test of endurance in the brand new [b]Arcade Mode[/b]!

Five worlds, three lives and one simple mission - board the shuttle at the summit!

Play through Lovely Planet 2 like it's '85 again!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/a6c32e9e9a0243c23bc38235949dc1ab60afd02d.gif[/img]

Complete the game, start to finish, without losing all your [b]lives[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/8b19df7810fea93323e7a3045fc3b20c8344fa8e.png[/img]

Explore to find hidden [b]pickups[/b] that replenish your life!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/8f7b96af1b6599dd50b4631061b9fa76fcb0bcf5.gif[/img]

Discover [b]shortcuts[/b] that bring you closer to your destination!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/2833aebfcd9080aa2313779f88f4db3bd91300e5.gif[/img]

Beat the game in one go, secure your position on the leaderboard and unlock [b]new achievements[/b]!

notes.title: Introducing Shops! (Update 8)
notes.notes:
Feel like changing into something more comfortable? Need a dry pair of pants after being drenched in the Forest? Feeling the chill up in the mountains? Or maybe the regular garb is just not to your liking.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/9c8590dae8c5fce59401e7ef7e33bed99b9e5778.png[/img]

Not to worry! Visit a shop today and score new threads! Explore to find five new shops, each offering a unique selection of different colors. Pick the color that suits your personality and adventure to Lovely Planet in style.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/056ed383ea88beff7b5021f1da92ae5fe1113af3.png[/img]

This update also adds six new achievements for you to unlock.

Following are the fixes included in this update.
[list]
[*]☯ mode is now made accessible from the world select menu (only made available after you've beat the game)
[*]A tiny modification on hidden level 3-14
[*]☯ mode rebalanced
[/list]
Please let me know if there’s any bugs that might have slipped into this update. I will address them in a jiffy.

notes.title: Update 7
notes.notes:
Few little fixes and some quality of life improvements.

You can now set an override to your default sensitivity settings via the extra options menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/3bc8fc3a530730611e30c30e709bb22069e91083.png[/img]

It accepts an integer value between 0-100 via keyboard input that maps to the 0-10 of the default slider which should give you more precise control over the sensitivity setting. You can also input values greater than 100 if you'd like to make it more sensitive. Setting the values to zero will disable the override and default back to the slider.

[list]
[*]Selected items in the options menu are now highlighted to make it easier to read.

[*]The "Controller" option is pushed below the sensitivity sliders so it doesn't look like the "X-Speed" and "Y-Speed" options are for controllers specifically.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/0cf57596b275c304dd360cba6c046fda063204f0.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/b53986e3903e16ec028f3214138f6d1997e8025a.png[/img][/url]

[*]Locked worlds are greyed out in the world menu.

[*]Fixed a bug where the background music was muted in the Legacy levels playlist.

[*]Levels will no longer reset if you spend more than 99.99 seconds. Recorded times will still cap at 99.99

[/list]

This update also rewires some of the insides of the game to prepare it for future content updates. If you happen to find anything out of the ordinary, please let me know and I will fix it asap.

Cheers

notes.title: Lovely Planet 2 is a sequel to the fast-flinging FPS
notes.notes:
Lovely Planet 2: April Skies appears to follow closely in the footsteps of its predecessor. Both original and sequel are first person shooter gun ballets that combine colourful-cute graphics with bounce-o-dodge platforming and lots of shooting. Replay for faster times, to find secrets you missed, or in new game plus mode for more difficult challenges. Here s a trailer showing off the combination of cheery art and fast-paced fighting.

(more…)

notes.title: Update 6
notes.notes:
Key rebinding is live!

You can access the key configuration options via the extra options menu at the bottom of the settings menu.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/f1da4a7cd1387c8d003ec376e1bf84ffe79b2ba4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/305da4343ea3f95512aabdfe3cf0dfbc79c0e809.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/b7c4017577abc2942f48bd987d73eebc0140c20e.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/26e59a6dc5c7ce9018cdfbec72077c38e327e1c1.png[/img][/url]

To rebind custom keys, select the “Rebind..” option to access the rebinding menu.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/0aa8c1a3037fe2b1aba5d6b5efe90b99cc5a4c3f.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/ab9f9b4d16a0aac3af8752c779769ee5b9827130.png[/img][/url]

Selecting the “Set WASD” option should reset all controls to the default keyboard configuration.

[i]forward → W
left → A
right → D
backward → S
restart → R
jump → Space
fire → Mouse0
submit → E
back → Q
look → F[/i]

Selecting the “Set ZQSD” option should reset all controls to the default AZERTY keyboard configuration

[i]forward → Z
left → Q
right → D
backward → S
restart → R
jump → Space
fire → Mouse0
submit → E
back → A
look → F[/i]

Also, with this update, all times set with 100% accuracy on the leaderboards will carry a yellow star (★) after the name!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/02f860484445fc3db8f67057f6d1b03181a7c1f4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/615f55697f61c9c95e4c54dc64a3b353a1741fed.png[/img][/url]

Cheers

notes.title: Update 5
notes.notes:
Addressed another issue where players would get stuck mid-air in a jump on higher framerates.

Special thanks and tip of the hat once again to user apa3 for helping identify and troubleshoot this bug.

Also fixed a very minor issue with baddie death sounds reverbing when they're not supposed to.

Hope you're enjoying the game!

Cheers

notes.title: Update 4 [HOTFIX]
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where player movement is severely delayed when using the keyboard at very high refresh rates.

This is a hotfix. The game now maxes out at a 240 frames per second to alleviate this problem temporarily. We will address this issue in further updates once I have thoroughly diagnosed the root cause of this problem.

Special thanks to user apa3 for bringing this to my attention. I appreciate all the help and feedback!

My most sincerest apologies for these issues. Hopefully with this update the game is in a playable state for everyone.

Cheers

notes.title: Update 3
notes.notes:
Fixes framerate and v-sync settings. Mouse movement should now be framerate independent on all settings. Also adds an in-game timer on the HUD.

We've added an extra settings menu to allow players to change more advanced settings. Select the new "..." option at the very bottom of the settings menu to access the new menu.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/f1da4a7cd1387c8d003ec376e1bf84ffe79b2ba4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/305da4343ea3f95512aabdfe3cf0dfbc79c0e809.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/f60eed389588f1a03ba2cfd285be969bdea97961.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/753a07bc7a474aac6a37bed569f64e6324173340.png[/img][/url]

The in-game timer on the HUD can be toggled with the "--/--" option. Scroll through the "FPS Cap" option to set the framerate cap to 30, 60, 120 and 144, or turn it off entirely.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/8db85c0f35ed70972dd59d22e3452f7221fe669d.png[/img]

To make sure you're on the latest build, look for the "v3" watermark on the top right hand corner of the screen in the main menu.

Please let me know if the issue still persists for you, in the comments below or the forums. Alternatively you can also reach me directly at support@quicktequila.com

Thanks for your patience!

Cheers

NOTE : For all those of you who moved to the beta branch for the last update, can switch back now the default branch to receive updates. To switch to the default branch, right-click on the game in your library, select "Properties". You'll find a "Betas" tab that allows you to select between the default and beta branch.

notes.title: Update 3 [BETA]
notes.notes:
Fixing framerate issues and adding the in-game HUD timer.

If you make your way to the bottom of the settings menu, you'll see a "..." option that spawns an extra settings menu.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/f1da4a7cd1387c8d003ec376e1bf84ffe79b2ba4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/305da4343ea3f95512aabdfe3cf0dfbc79c0e809.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/f60eed389588f1a03ba2cfd285be969bdea97961.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/753a07bc7a474aac6a37bed569f64e6324173340.png[/img][/url]

This menu contains a toggle for the in-game HUD timer and frame limiter settings. You can choose to set the framerate cap to 30, 60, 120 and 144, or turn it off entirely.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/8db85c0f35ed70972dd59d22e3452f7221fe669d.png[/img]

I've put this together in a bit of a rush so it's pending a round of internal testing and QA. Until then, this update will be waiting in the beta branch. To switch to the beta branch, right-click on the game in your library, select "Properties". You'll find a "Beta" tab that allows you to select between the default and beta branch.

NOTE: I'm pretty confident of beta builds, but since this update alters game settings I don't want to jump the gun until it's tested on more machines with different configurations. Try it at your own risk. You can always revert back to the default branch, but if the beta build alters your settings you might have to reset them manually. If you switch successfully, the updated game should show a "v3[BETA]" watermark on the top right hand corner of the screen in the main menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/00bb836785587c60e5967ffe6ac8b3539153830b.png[/img]

If you take this for a spin, let me know if it solves the v-sync and framerate issue for you. I'll try to get this update finished as soon as possible! Thanks a lot for your patience!

Cheers

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
Mouse acceleration is pretty awful.

Some players have reported a frame dependent mouse movement. I've pushed an update to address this issue. The updated version of the game should show a "v2" on the top right hand corner of the screen in the main menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35211895/84db74773eedcd7882540a4ed6900868b0523068.png[/img]

Please let me know if you're still experiencing mouse acceleration or a lag of any kind and I will look into it further.

Thanks

notes.title: Lovely Planet 2 is an abstract FPS arriving next week
notes.notes:
Quicktequila and TinyBuild have announced Lovely Planet 2: April Skies, a sequel to 2014's bouncy FPS. Once again you'll need to hop around a pleasant, pastel world, shooting angry little creatures and dodging bullets. The release date is soon, too, and you'll be able to brush up on your murderous skills next week. 

You'll have to shoot and leap across more than 100 levels and five worlds, while a new game mode will let you return to them to take on greater challenges. Expect a some hidden levels, too, along with other secrets dotted around the floating islands. 

Honestly, I feel a little bit guilty at the thought of slaughtering my way through such a  friendly looking place. Even the buildings have faces. I don't want a house to judge me for shooting some wee monsters. 

Lovely Planet 2: April Skies is due out on June 18.
